prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
The evidence is still thin as only one test has been completed so far.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- sign_in, reorder: +0.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Desktop Control Guide Screen: Insert a new onboarding screen showing how to hide, summon, and interact with the desktop pet right before home introduction. (why: Multiple support emails reported post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to their desktop pet.)
1: [home, new_flow] Waiting Screen Live Stage Flow & Tips: Transform the waiting screen into a stage layout with tip carousels, progress indicators, and desktop background preparation info. (why: The waiting stage takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading to drop-offs while waiting for asset generation.)
2: [choose_path, redesign] Split View Creation Path Selection: Redesign the choose path screen into a split view with animated mascot previews comparing ready-made vs custom pet options. (why: The choose path step takes a mean time of 514s and converts at 76.2%, indicating confusion between the path choices.)
3: [sign_in, wait_info] Sign-In Persistence & Data Safeguard Info: Display explicit account persistence messaging and cloud backup badges on the sign-in screen. (why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or resetting after signing in again, making account binding clarity critical.)
4: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Guidelines & Quality Hint: Add photo quality instructions and a tip carousel to the custom photo upload screen. (why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or looking distorted after uploading photos.)
5: [finish, layout] Desktop Overlay Permission Checklist: Add a display permission checklist to home_intro to verify the pet overlay can appear over other windows. (why: 3 support tickets reported pets failing to appear on the desktop or the app refusing to open properly.)
6: [adoption, layout] Grid Layout for Pet Selection Screen: Re-layout the pick_friend screen into a grid format featuring choice cards and sound preview buttons. (why: Adoption has a high drop-off rate (60.9% conversion), so a clearer grid layout speeds up pet selection.)
7: [home, notification] Background Notification System for Pet Preparation: Add system tray notification settings and time estimate counters to the waiting screen. (why: The waiting step mean duration is 2336s, causing user abandonment while background setup completes.)

Split view redesign reduces path selection confusion.
Low cost text/badge update backed by strong support email volume.
Simple hint on adoption step which has the highest drop-off rate.
Checklist solves technical overlay issues reported in support tickets.
Grid layout speeds up selection in high-friction adoption step.
Background notification mitigates abandonment during long preparation time.
